prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1228; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact was hard enough to push me forward against my seatbelt, and I felt an immediate stiffness and pain in my neck and upper back. I stayed at the scene until the other driver and the responding officer had finished speaking with me. I have described the events the same way each time I have been asked, whether at the scene, to the adjuster, or to my doctor. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am filing this claim for the medical treatment I have needed since the collision, including visits for whiplash and the physical therapy my doctor recommended. I am willing to provide any further records that would help process this claim.
